@topic fmt-permutations

Q: In how many ways can 3 students be chosen from 6 for a committee?
A: 20
W: 120
W: 18
W: 15
E: Order does not matter: 6C3 = 6! ÷ (3! × 3!) = 20.

@topic fmt-calculus

Q: Evaluate the integral of 2x from x = 0 to x = 3.
A: 9
W: 6
W: 18
W: 2
E: ∫ 2x dx = x². At x = 3: 1 × 3² = 9; at 0 it is 0.
